player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I fell into a repetitive loop, repeatedly traversing the path between the Bathroom, Music room, and Garage without exploring the unvisited branches. Specifically, when I returned to the Bathroom multiple times, I kept choosing "south" or "east" which led back to known areas, ignoring the "west" option that eventually led to the Media room. I also failed to recognize that the Media room had an unexplored "north" direction. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and directions. When I encounter a room I have visited before, I will explicitly check for any available directions I have not yet taken from that specific room. If I am in the Bathroom and have already tried south and east, I must prioritize west. If I am in the Media room, I must try north immediately. I will only declare "DONE" once I have confirmed the current room is the "Game room".
